snippets.PANDABEARD_SPEECH_01: Hey, thanks for visiting me again in my bar.
snippets.PANDABEARD_SPEECH_02: What? Kamaria wants the key to the treasure chest that I gave her? I thought she'd just use it as decoration for her tower. I have to think about where I put it. Come back tomorrow. It'll surely come to me by then.
snippets.PANDABEARD_SPEECH_03: You'd like to have the key for Kamaria's treasure chest? I hid it somewhere a long time ago. But where was it...hmmm....
snippets.PANDABEARD_SPEECH_04: Ah, now I know! I hung the key somewhere on a little hook. I don't remember where it is exactly, but I remember something fluttering around my ears as I did it. I got scared and ran away. Maybe you have an idea where that could be. I'm sure you can find the key.
snippets.PANDI_MC_SPEECH_02: You want my alarm clock? Are you crazy? This clock is a piece of my hip outfit. It looks cool, don't it?
snippets.PANDI_MC_SPEECH_03: Well you should have said that you need it to wake up the Wooby leader! Here, you can have it. Good luck and come visit me more often, ya hear?
snippets.QUESTTRANSITION_3_BLOCK:
Dear Panda,
Please finish this quest first. Before you can start the quest The lost Wooby king, Kamaria needs your help very urgently.
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_01: Hey! Can you hear that whimpering and whining? I can't take it anymore! Woobys are naturally always a bit depressed, but I've never seen them so bad.
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_02: The Wooby leader has been missing for the past few days. He's like a father for the poor, parentless Woobys. He always lived here along the lake and ensured peace in the region. Since he's been gone, there's been sheer chaos. All they do is cry and fight!
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_03: Because of the staggering amount of Wooby tears, the water levels have been rising at the lake. If this continues, the monster water slide will be flooded! Please help me to calm down the Woobys. Look for a tissue to dry the Wooby tears and prevent the worst from happening!
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_04: What we need is a jumbo-sized pack of tissues. Surely you know the place to find such a thing.
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_05: Great, that should be enough. Go take care of the Woobys and dry off their tears. Hopefully that'll make them happy again.
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_06: The Woobys aren't crying quite so much anymore, but they still seem to be sad about something. I can't take it! For some reason my clownish ways and sunny disposition don't seem to be cheering them up.
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_07: Find the Wooby leader and bring him here. I want this lake to be full of laughing and happiness!!
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_08: Lately I've been hiding in the castle bushes and have spied the Wooby leader visiting Kamaria. Maybe she will know what happened to him.
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_09: Go to the castle tower and ask Kamaria if she knows where the Wooby leader could be.
snippets.SPEECH_CURLEY_10: The Wooby leader is here once more! Finally we can all stop crying and laugh and play instead! Blow up a tube and have some fun!
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_01: What's that? The Wooby King has disappeared? Oh dear! I had asked him to take care of my herbs and potions, because I had been just so very busy over the last little while.
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_02: Wait a minute...the bottle containing my sleep potion has been knocked over. Someone drank from it!
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_03: Do you hear someone snoring? There's somebody here! And they are snoring so loud the windows are about to shatter!
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_04: Ah ha! So you see the treasure chest? Someone apparently fell in after falling asleep and the lid locked shut. I'm sure it's the Wooby leader! He just had to drink one of my potions. Wonderful.
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_05: We'll have to wake him up as soon as possible or else he will fall into a deeper and deeper sleep. Unfortunately I don't have a key for the trunk. You see, it was a gift from William Pandabeard. Go to the bar and ask him for the key. But hurry! We don't have much time!
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_06: Go to the pirate bar and ask Pandabeard for the key to the treasure chest.
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_08: So far, so good. Now we just have to wake up the Wooby leader. It won't be easy. Maybe we can try to give him some very strong coffee. Go and get a mug, please. Where you ask, well, I always like to have a cup of coffee after I have taken a long swim.
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_09: Drat! The coffee is too weak! I know. What we need is a very loud alarm clock. Where can we get one of those...?
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_10: I know! DJ Pandi has one hanging around his neck! Maybe we could get it from him.
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_11: Go to DJ Pandi in the disco and ask him if he'll give you his alarm clock.
snippets.SPEECH_KAMARIA_13: Phew, it worked. I will keep extra good track of my herbs and potions from now on. I won't trust them with anyone, even if they are the leader of this or that or the other thing. Thanks for you help. As a thank-you, you can keep the alarm clock. It'd look great as a clock in your tree house. Go back to the lake and tell Mr. Curly that everything will be okay. I'll send the Wooby leader after you.
